findings.message: No room-level test pins the 3 s length of a lockout. tests/integration/ruins.test.ts ('locks a wrong answer out for 3 s...') asserts only `wrong.lockedUntil >= LOCKOUT_TICKS` (60). lockedUntil is an absolute world tick, so this is nearly vacuous once the match has run 3 s. The test then only proves the refusal right after the answer and the solve once worldTick >= until (with a 5 s wait). The browser test's /try again in [123] s/ also accepts a 1 s lockout. The 3 s value is pinned only in the unowned pure module (puzzles.test.ts, operations.test.ts), so a room passing a wrong tick base for the lockout would go unnoticed. Suggest asserting lockedUntil minus the answer's tick equals 60.
findings.requirement: a wrong answer locks that player out for 3 s, and not others

findings.message: No test sends open-ruin from a player at sea and checks that no clue arrives. The room's `if (island === null) return` in MatchRoom.receiveOpenRuin is marked `equivalent` (row 20, open-at-sea) in docs/ruins-online-coverage.md. The integration tests cover opens in the lobby, in a duel, while respawning and after the end, but never from open water. The onlooker in the §16 test is at sea in sight of Palm Key but never sends open-ruin. So the room-level half of 'clue only to players moored at that island' is untested.
findings.requirement: Hidden information: a ruin's clue goes only to players moored at that island with an open session.
